verses.1: In the twelfth year of his reign, in one month, God spoke to me.
verses.2: Because of the words that were spoken about Jerusalem: its gates were closed, and its people were destroyed. It became a place of desolation.
verses.3: Therefore, thus said Adonai YHWH: “I am upon you. I have brought many nations upon you, just as the sea brings its waves upon it.”
verses.4: And they destroyed its walls and ruins them from their heights. I also removed its snow from there, and I gave it to the wind to destroy it completely.
verses.5: From the land of the camps, there will be a place within the sea. For I say this in the name of the Lord Jehovah. It will become a place for all nations to dwell in.
verses.6: And in her branches, which are in the field during the harvest time, they will be destroyed. And they will know that I am Jehovah.
verses.7: For as Adonai YHWH said, “I will bring Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, from the land of Sodom. He will be a king over kings, riding on horses, chariots, and wagons. He will have a large army and many people with him.”
verses.8: In your daughters, in the field, in the time of destruction, He will kill them. He will also pour out a curse upon you. He will build a wall around you.
verses.9: And in your joys, he will be given life; and in your hardships, he will be destroyed.
verses.10: From the noise of their horses, your gates will be covered with the sound of hooves and wheels. It will be a loud noise when they enter your gates, just like the noise of an invading city.
verses.11: In the days of Sausio, Yermos will destroy all your possessions. Your people will be destroyed in the wilderness. Your livestock will die on the ground.
verses.12: And they took away your army, and they destroyed your chariots. They also destroyed your homes and your treasures. Your stones, trees, and other valuables were all scattered across the waters.
verses.13: And my heart is filled with your songs, and the sound of your voice cannot be heard anymore.
verses.14: And I will give you a rock from the site of the ruins. It will no longer be used as a building site. For I, Jehovah, have spoken this. May the Lord do so!
verses.15: Thus said Adonai Yehovah: “From the sound of your trumpet in the wilderness, in the mountains where you reign over them, the Israelites will be destroyed.”
verses.16: And all the rulers of the sea came down from their thrones. They removed their coverings and their clothes of weaving. They were relieved of their fears. They sat down on the earth, and for a moment, they remained in silence.
verses.17: And they will say to you, “How have you lost your place? You were once a part of the city that was praised by the seas. Its inhabitants were given land for their settlement.”
verses.18: Now, the islands will be in fear on the day you come. The islands that lie in the sea will be terrified when you approach them.
verses.19: For thus said Adonai Yehovah to me: “I will give you a city that will be destroyed, just like those cities that were never inhabited. It will be covered with water.”
verses.20: And you shall bring down the ruins of Bor to the world, and you shall place them in a land where they will remain in ruins forever. You shall do this so that they will not remain there, and I will give them a life in the land of living beings.
verses.21: In those days, you will be and you won’t be; I will ask for help, but I won’t find anyone to help me anymore. Please, Adonai YHWH, do not let this happen forever.
